subject: english
stem: A note explains that the river path will close for repairs from May 3 to May 6 and gives a safe alternate route. Why was it written?
options: to describe how rivers form and warn all users away from every path
to warn users of a closure and guide them around it
to invite users to repair the path

optionRationales.reason: to warn users of a closure and guide them around it：關閉日期與 alternate route 服務安全通行。
to invite users to repair the path：沒有招募。
to praise the longest route：沒有評價或長度比較。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文體、內容安排與讀者預期行動共同指向的寫作目的」可推出 to warn users of a closure and guide them around it；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 to warn users of a closure and guide them around it 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
